specs.Portable BT Speaker: Take your music anywhere with the ZEB-County Pro 11, a compact Bluetooth speaker designed for easy portability and entertainment on the move.
specs.Dynamic Output: Fill your space with rich 16 W sound, perfect for gatherings, outdoor fun, or simply enjoying your favorite playlist.
specs.Longer Playtime: Enjoy up to 24 hours of playtime (at 50% volume, LED off) with the built-in rechargeable battery for uninterrupted music.
specs.Powerful Drivers: Dual 10.16 cm drivers deliver deep, punchy bass and a balanced sound for an immersive listening experience.
specs.TWS Function: Pair two ZEB-County Pro 11 units with the TWS feature to create a wider, more engaging stereo soundstage.
specs.RGB LED Lights: Add flair to your music with RGB LED lights featuring four dynamic modes, complemented by a built-in carry handle for easy transport.
specs.Multi-connectivity: Stay connected with multiple playback options—BT v5.4, USB, microSD, and AUX input—for flexible listening.
